# Architecture decision template

Create `docs/decisions/NNNN-short-name.md` when a decision is required by the
delivery contracts. This template records no accepted decision itself.

## ADR-NNNN: <decision>

- Status: proposed / accepted / superseded
- Date:
- Scope/authorization: <user request or existing approved feature scope>
- Affected AC IDs and packages:
- Supersedes / superseded by:

## Context and evidence

<Problem, current owners and code/test evidence; constraints and uncertainties.>

## Decision and alternatives

<Chosen behaviour, why it fits, alternatives considered and tradeoffs.
If proposed, state the unresolved choice instead of implying approval.>

## Consequences and transition

<Interfaces and all affected consumers; data/schema compatibility; rollout,
recovery, operational cost, and any temporary exception with an expiry/removal
condition and responsible package.>

## Verification and contract updates

<Acceptance evidence required; exact contracts and reference documents that
must change. Record results when implemented. An accepted design is not proof
that its implementation has shipped.>
